questions.def: «Build» qurilish uchun ishlatiladigan asosiy feʼl: «build a park».
questions.question: The city is planning to ___ a new park.

questions.def: «Street» ham «road» ham yoʻl degani, shuning uchun ular sinonim.
questions.question: What is a synonym for street?

questions.def: «Urban» shahar bilan bogʻliq; aksi — qishloq maʼnosidagi «rural».
questions.question: What is the opposite of urban?

questions.def: «Area» muayyan hudud yoki maydonni bildiradi.
questions.question: What does area mean?

questions.def: «Public transport» — avtobus, metro kabi hamma foydalanadigan transport.
questions.question: In London most people travel to work by bus or underground, that is, by public ___.

questions.def: «Design» arxitektor chizgan loyiha va koʻrinish, yaʼni dizayn.
questions.question: The architect spent months drawing the plan, and the final ___ of the building is very nice.

questions.def: «Center» ham «middle» ham oʻrta, markaziy qismni bildiradi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for center?

questions.def: «Narrow» tor; uning aksi — keng maʼnosidagi «wide».
questions.question: What is the opposite of narrow?

questions.def: «Location» biror narsaning joyi yoki oʻrnini bildiradi.
questions.question: What does location mean?

questions.def: «City planning» — shaharda nima qayerda boʻlishini rejalashtirish.
questions.question: Deciding where houses, roads and parks should be built is called city ___.

questions.def: Faqat «bridge» transport harakatiga taʼsir qiladi; qolganlari yoʻl bilan bogʻliq emas.
questions.question: The new ___ will help traffic flow.

questions.def: Britaniya ingliz tilida «flat», Amerikada «apartment» — bir xil maʼno.
questions.question: What is a synonym for apartment?

questions.def: «Inside» ichkarida; uning aksi — tashqarida maʼnosidagi «outside».
questions.question: What is the opposite of inside?

questions.def: «Sidewalk» yoʻl yonidagi piyodalar yoʻlagi.
questions.question: What does sidewalk mean?

questions.def: «Building materials» — gʻisht, beton, poʻlat kabi qurilish xomashyosi.
questions.question: Brick, concrete and steel are all common building ___.

questions.def: «Repair» buzilgan narsani tuzatish; teshik tom va yoriq devor shuni talab qiladi.
questions.question: The roof is leaking and the walls are cracked, so the old building needs ___.

questions.def: «House» ham «home» ham yashash joyi, uy degani.
questions.question: What is a synonym for house?

questions.def: «Modern» zamonaviy; uning aksi — eski maʼnosidagi «old».
questions.question: What is the opposite of modern?

questions.def: «Garden» oʻsimlik, gul va daraxtlar ekilgan joy.
questions.question: What does garden mean?

questions.def: «Traffic lights» — harakatni boshqaruvchi svetofor.
questions.question: traffic ___

questions.def: «Population» aholi soni; faqat u «high» sifati bilan tabiiy birikadi.
questions.question: The ___ in the city is very high.

questions.def: Shahar kontekstida «area» va «zone» ikkisi ham muayyan hududni bildiradi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for area (in context of city)?

questions.def: «Tall» baland; uning aksi — past maʼnosidagi «short».
questions.question: What is the opposite of tall?

questions.def: «Neighbor» yonma-yon yoki yaqin atrofda yashovchi kishi.
questions.question: What does neighbor mean?

questions.def: «Neighborhood» — shaharning odamlar yashaydigan kichik, yaqin atrofdagi qismi.
questions.question: A small part of a town where people live close to each other is called a ___.

questions.def: «Improve» yaxshilash; hukumat shaharni buzmaydi, balki yaxshilaydi.
questions.question: The government wants to ___ the city.

questions.def: «Structure» qurilma degani; shahar haqida gapirganda sinonimi «building».
questions.question: What is a synonym for structure?

questions.def: «Safe» xavfsiz; uning aksi — xavfli maʼnosidagi «dangerous».
questions.question: What is the opposite of safe?

questions.def: «Rent» biror narsadan foydalanish uchun pul toʻlash, ijaraga olish.
questions.question: What does rent mean?

questions.def: «City business center» — banklar va ofislar joylashgan shahar markazi.
questions.question: Banks, offices and company headquarters are all found in the city ___ center.
